sn36.8:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Vesaliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane kuṭāgārasālāyaṃ || || 2
sn36.8:4.4: Sato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sampajāno kālam āgameyya- 6
sn36.8:5.1: Tassa ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno evaṃ satassa sampajānassa appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato uppajjati sukhā vedanā ||
sn36.8:5.4: sā ca kho paṭicca no appaṭicca
sn36.8:5.7: ayaṃ kho pana phasso anicco saṅkhato paṭicca samuppanno ||
sn36.8:5.8: aniccaṃ kho pana saṅkhataṃ paṭicca samuppannam phassam paṭicca uppannā sukhā vedanā kuto niccā bhavissatīti ||
